web.title: 100 Color Combinations To Influence Your Next Design - Figma
web.description:
# 100 color combinations to influence your next design
## [**100 inspiring color combinations**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#_100-inspiring-color-combinations)
### [**Romantic color combinations**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#romantic-color-combinations)
#### [**Combination 12: Blooming romance**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-12-blooming-romance)
This color palette combines rich shades to bring a sense of sophistication and luxury to UI designs.

#### [**Combination 13: Desert dusk**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-13-desert-dusk)
This color combination evokes a sense of sophistication with a touch of warmth. [Cognac’s](https://www.figma.com/colors/cognac/) reddish brown hue, along with muted orange and purple shades, offers a luxurious feel, making this palette just right for websites that sell high-end products and luxury goods.

#### [**Combination 20: Iris garden**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-20-iris-garden)
This color palette includes a tapestry of [lilac](https://www.figma.com/colors/lilac/) and [sage](https://www.figma.com/colors/sage/) hues, as seen in an iris garden. The purple shades offer a sense of luxury, while the muted green hues add a natural touch to keep the UI from feeling overly dark.

#### [**Combination 22: Golden hour**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-22-golden-hour)
Warm amber, [muted gold](https://www.figma.com/colors/gold/), and [mauve pink](https://www.figma.com/colors/mauve-pink/) echo the glow of golden hour, balancing energy with calm.

#### [**Combination 26: Pastel garden**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-26-pastel-garden)
A blend of deep rose, [blush pink](https://www.figma.com/colors/blush-pink/), and muted gray-green creates a soft, romantic vibe. Sophisticated yet gentle, this palette works beautifully for brands aiming to convey timeless elegance and classic charm.

### [**Playful color combinations**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#playful-color-combinations)
#### [**Combination 31: Pistachio dream**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-31-pistachio-dream)
[Pastel green](https://www.figma.com/colors/pastel-green/) and other muted shades of green bring a sense of freshness and youthfulness to this color combination. This color palette can also promote concentration without being overly stimulating—a perfect environment for productivity platforms.

### [**Vibrant color combinations**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#vibrant-color-combinations)
#### [**Combination 41: Alchemical reaction**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-41-alchemical-reaction)
This color palette’s [purple](https://www.figma.com/colors/purple/), orange, and green hues create an intriguing and slightly scientific feel.

#### [**Combination 53: Cobalt sky**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-53-cobalt-sky)
![Cobalt sky color palette](https://cdn.sanity.io/images/599r6htc/regionalized/d7363ca190c29bc0984a98f56af756121f9715cb-1440x868.png?w=1440&h=868&q=75&fit=max&auto=format)

From bright [cobalt](https://www.figma.com/colors/cobalt-blue/) to deep [navy](https://www.figma.com/colors/navy-blue/), this range feels both credible and energetic, like twilight shifting into night.

### [**Neutral color combinations**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#neutral-color-combinations)
#### [**Combination 58: Gothic noir**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-58-gothic-noir)
Using the lightest shade as the background and the other shades for highlights and accents leads to a pleasing design that’s not overly dark.

#### [**Combination 60: Quiet luxury**](https://www.figma.com/resource-library/color-combinations/#combination-60-quiet-luxury)
This soft color palette is perfect for wedding websites or fashion brands celebrating romance. [Champagne’s](https://www.figma.com/colors/champagne/) yellow and pink undertones evoke elegance, while the muted pink and brown hues give a vintage feel.

web.description:
# 50 Gorgeous Color Schemes From Award-Winning Websites
## 1 Metallic Chic
![website color schemes - Metallic chic](https://visme.co/blog/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/2.jpg)

This website color palette is full of metallic touches over a blue-toned gradient creating a chic 3D setup for Shopify’s product updates.

## 2 Deep Vintage Mood
The vintage color palette on the Prometheus website includes an earthy terracotta with a deep blue gradient and the sleek black of the car.

## 3 Cool and Collected
Deep teals and bright metallics create an innovative color palette that transitions from dark to light in an animated video.

## 16 Sleek and Futuristic
This eye-catching blend of blue sapphire, gunmetal gray and platinum on the one hand and peach-orange and tan on the other make for a modern and sleek color scheme. Used here to project a futuristic image, the cool, metallic colors are effectively tempered by more human, earthy tones.

## 17 Innovative and Audacious
This in-your-face combination of Portland Orange, vivid yellow and jade on a dark gray, almost black background screams for your attention.

## 25 Vibrant and Elegant
This bright and elegant color scheme brings together a very saturated light cold blue with other shades, such as dark slate blue and pale cornflower blue. This combination is elegantly complemented by a bright and vivid shade of pink.

## 41 Intrepid and Fearless
This effective color combination uses shades of blue and red to create a sense of boldness and ardent professionalism, ideal for designs looking to convey power and competence.

## 47 Glamorous and Fashion-Forward
This blend of gold, purple and black bring to mind words such as wealth and extravagance.
